visible.title: Server hangs on startup when offline
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

When I run streamlit 

### Reproducible Code Example

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Disable your internet connection
2. Run `streamlit hello` or `streamlit run some_script.py` (preferably with development mode on to see more logs)
3. Observe that the server does not fully start (the streamlit web app page is stuck loading), and the runtime reports no connected sessions
4. 2-5 minutes later, see that the server does start, along with many tornado endpoint hits processed all at once.

### Expected Behavior

Server starts right away even with no active internet connection

### Current Behavior

### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.32.2
- Python version: 3.11.1
- Operating System: Fedora 36
- Browser: Firefox 112.0.1

### Additional Information

gold.summary: Server hangs for minutes on startup when offline (clear repro steps given).
hypotheses: network call at startup without timeout (version check / external IP lookup)

missing_info.why: startup code path differs in headless mode

acceptable_next_steps: Escalate the reproducible offline startup hang and request debug timing around startup.
Ask/test effective headless and usage-statistics/version-check settings as discriminating diagnostics.
must_not: State get_external_ip is the confirmed root cause at intake.
Claim a 2026 timeout fix was available in March 2024.
gold.reference: User found headless mode calls get_external_ip(); confirmed; fixed with a timeout (2026).
gold.review_reason: Explicit offline steps, versions and a minutes-long startup delay support escalation with targeted diagnostics. Headless/external-IP root cause emerges later that evening, so it must remain a hypothesis initially.

acceptable_next_steps: Escalate with repro; ask about config (headless, gatherUsageStats) to narrow the network call
Suggest debug logging to locate the hang
must_not: say it cannot be reproduced without trying the given steps

gold.acceptable_why: Hani: targeted diagnostics (headless, usage-stats/version-check settings) are acceptable next steps
